notes.title: status update
notes.notes:
All hands on deck!

BAD team is pleased to share another piece of information on the progress of work on the second chapter of the "Neighboring  Islands". So, let's start:

1. More than 70% of the graphics are drawn.
2. The Russian version of the game has long passed the equator for writing code and confidently moves to a mark of 80%.
3. The translation is completed by 80%.

Most likely, we will finish the graphics earlier code of both versions of the game. In connection with which little by little work is already under way to improve the art of the first chapter. For example, the sprites of the "talking head" of the main character have already been redrawn (a couple of examples of "it was," you can see below). This is done because we do not stand still and the accumulated experience allows us to look at the way we have already traversed. We do not want to say that we will change much in the first chapter, but some of the artifacts will be updated when the second part comes out and a little more when the third one leaves.

For this, let me bow out. The works, as you can see, are in full swing and it is possible that next month the second chapter of the islands will be released on Steam in the form of a FREE update for everyone who will already have the first part of our game activated.


https://pbs.twimg.com/media/DA05KcAWsAANNQI.jpg
